nodes.label: Tech Tree Animation Sequence (Frames 564–640)
nodes.description: A 3D CGI animation sequence (chunk 24 of 48, frames 564–640) depicting a stylized glowing tree with blue bioluminescent roots/circuit-like tendrils emerging from a dark pedestal. The animation shows a transition: initially the tree is framed by two cracked, opening black shell/pod halves with blue-lit internal structures, suggesting emergence or awakening. Later frames show the tree fully revealed, standing alone with glowing blue root networks spreading across the ground — evoking themes of nature fused with technology, growth, and digital/organic synthesis. Watermark 'Veo' is visible, indicating AI-generated video (Google Veo). These frames are part of a looping or sequential animation likely used as a hero or background visual on the Softree website.
nodes.note: Source files ezgif-frame-564 through ezgif-frame-640 were not found on disk; content was inferred from sampled frames ezgif-frame-001 and ezgif-frame-120 which are part of the same animation sequence.
